description: Find x402 services that answer right now ($0.005 USDC): searches our daily census of the Coinbase Bazaar (about 34,000 listings) by words, optionally under a maximum price, and checks the top results live. Each result says whether it answered with 402, how fast, and whether its live price still matches the listing. At most two results per host.

maxPrice.description: maximum price per call in USDC

payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 payment payload you signed yourself (ERC-3009 TransferWithAuthorization, USDC on Base). Call without it once to receive the payment requirements, sign those, then call again with this argument. This server forwards the payload and never holds a key.

q.description: words to look for, e.g. "weather forecast"

name: find_x402_services
